name: Bridge Result Comparison
description: Compare repeated analyses or sampled mesh studies by explicit physical keys. No interpolation. Criterion: abs(delta) <= absolute tolerance + relative tolerance * abs(reference).

inputs.name: Reference keys
inputs.description: Unique physical labels, e.g. girder/station/case/quantity. Do not rely on element IDs that change with remeshing.

inputs.description: Reference numerical values; all comparisons must use coherent units.

inputs.name: Candidate keys
inputs.description: Same physical key set, any order.

inputs.name: Candidate values
inputs.description: Candidate values in the same units as the reference.

inputs.name: Absolute tolerance
inputs.description: Tolerance in the units of the compared quantity.

outputs.name: All within tolerance
outputs.description: All supplied comparisons pass; does not establish mesh convergence by itself.

outputs.name: Relative difference
outputs.description: Difference / abs(reference). NaN for non-zero difference against zero.

outputs.name: Governing labels

name: Bridge Action
description: Bind one incremental FEM case to a stable action identifier and a section behavior.

inputs.name: Action ID
inputs.description: Stable identifier used by combination headers; independent of phase number and source model order.

inputs.name: Case
inputs.description: Load case object or exact analysed case name. A Value List offers the available cases.

inputs.name: Behavior
inputs.description: 0 Steel; 1 Long term n infinity; 2 Short term n0. Use Bridge Shrinkage Action for shrinkage.

inputs.name: Beam IDs
inputs.description: Optional selection of beam IDs. Empty applies this action to all beams.

name: Bridge Shrinkage Action
description: One shrinkage action: concrete strain increment plus secondary FEM forces. A single combination coefficient scales both.

inputs.name: Action ID
inputs.description: Single stable identifier for both shrinkage contributions in combinations.

inputs.name: Model
inputs.description: Source of secondary FEM forces calculated on the n shrinkage section.

inputs.name: Case
inputs.description: Secondary FEM load case object or exact name.

inputs.name: Strain increment
inputs.description: Concrete shrinkage increment [dimensionless], negative for contraction. Supply the same increment to Composite Shrinkage Actions before Straus. Never enter cumulative shrinkage twice.

inputs.name: Beam IDs
inputs.description: Beams with this composite action; empty means all beams. Select longitudinal composite girders in a grillage.

inputs.name: Primary Only
inputs.description: Explicitly omit global restraint forces. Only valid when Model/Case are not used for FEM forces.

inputs.name: Response
inputs.description: 0 n shrinkage (default); 1 n0 for an explicitly instantaneous concrete strain increment. FEM forces, when present, must use the same response.

outputs.name: Action
outputs.description: Unified shrinkage action for Bridge Phase.

name: Bridge Phase
description: Numbered construction phase containing incremental actions. Order is independent of source model order.

inputs.name: Name
inputs.description: Readable phase label. Renaming does not change action identifiers.

inputs.name: Section State
inputs.description: 0 Steel; 1 Composite active; 2 Concrete excluded (LinearHistory only). This describes the section, not automatic activation of global Straus elements.

inputs.name: Actions
inputs.description: List of Bridge Action / Bridge Shrinkage Action objects. Empty allows an activation-only phase.

inputs.name: Day
inputs.description: Optional elapsed days, metadata only: no automatic age-dependent creep model.

outputs.name: Phase
outputs.description: Numbered phase for Build BridGHe Model.

name: Build BridGHe Model
description: Assemble numbered phases and incremental actions. One combination column per action, including unified shrinkage.

inputs.name: Models
inputs.description: Reference model(s), N-mm-MPa, with matching beam IDs/geometry. Action objects carry their own analysed sources; list order does not identify cases.

inputs.name: Phases
inputs.description: List of numbered Bridge Phase objects. Sorted by Number, with unique action identifiers.

inputs.name: Combinations
inputs.description: Table/tree: header label + action IDs, followed by combination name + coefficients. A shrinkage coefficient applies to both primary strain and secondary FEM forces.

inputs.name: Calculation
inputs.description: 0 Cumulative: existing numerical method grouped by section behavior; 1 LinearHistory: gPC sequential N–Mx section history. Neither runs global construction stages automatically.

outputs.description: Assembled model with source results and phase recipe.
